annotations.title: Set what goes toward goals and debts each month

description: Set the monthly amount toward a goal, or the extra on a debt: the Plan bucket for it, in the default plan. The difference comes from (or goes back to) Plan's Everything else, as on the Goals and Debts screens; a goal or debt with no bucket gets one. **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first.

amounts.description: One entry per goal or debt. Up to 60 in a call.

amount.description: Major units a month, 0 or more.

debt.description: A debt, by id or by name.

goal.description: A goal, by id or by name. Give this or `debt`.

commit.description: Default false. False previews; true writes.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

name: set_goal_amounts
title: Set what goes toward goals and debts each month
